note: Draft by 73 (2026-11-08) for the admin console. Keys are the contract (router/core codes); labels and descriptions are draft copy for 4f to edit. Lookup order: groups[group].codes[key], then patterns (first match, {1}.. = capture groups), then fallback. Render every value as text, never as HTML. Rule text is not here: it comes from the pack archive by packVersion (research note §2.4).

desc.en: Not in this console's code table (newer router, or a sanitized value). Shown as logged.
desc.zh-CN: 不在控制台代码表中（router 版本更新或值已被清洗）。按日志原样显示。

desc.en: First served decision of this lineage: a model was chosen with no current model.
desc.zh-CN: 该会话链的首个决策：在没有当前模型时选定模型。

desc.en: Stayed on the lineage's current model.
desc.zh-CN: 继续使用该会话链的当前模型。

desc.en: Moved the lineage to a different model (the new model starts with a cold prompt cache).
desc.zh-CN: 将会话链切换到另一个模型（新模型的提示缓存从零开始）。

desc.en: The client fixed the model (concrete model id or x-router-pin); the router did not choose.
desc.zh-CN: 客户端指定了模型（具体模型 ID 或 x-router-pin），router 未做选择。

desc.en: No routing decision: the model was fixed by the request.
desc.zh-CN: 无路由决策：模型由请求指定。

desc.en: The request returns a tool result inside an agent loop; switching here would break the loop, so the model is kept.
desc.zh-CN: 请求处于工具调用循环中（返回工具结果），此处切换会打断循环，因此保持模型。

desc.en: The request continues a stored response (previous_response_id), which only the same model can read.
desc.zh-CN: 请求延续已存储的响应（previous_response_id），只有同一模型能读取。

desc.en: The history carries provider-specific state (e.g. thinking signatures) that no eligible other model accepts.
desc.zh-CN: 对话历史含有特定提供方的状态（如 thinking 签名），其他可选模型无法接受。

desc.en: First request of a new session: a free break point (no cache to lose).
desc.zh-CN: 新会话的第一个请求：免费决策点（没有可丢失的缓存）。

desc.en: First request of a sub-agent lineage under a known session: a free break point.
desc.zh-CN: 已知会话下子 agent 会话链的第一个请求：免费决策点。

desc.en: The client marked a new task (x-router-boundary: task-start): a free break point.
desc.zh-CN: 客户端标记了新任务（x-router-boundary: task-start）：免费决策点。

desc.en: The lineage was idle past its prompt-cache TTL, so its cache is cold anyway: a free break point.
desc.zh-CN: 会话链空闲超过提示缓存 TTL，缓存已失效：免费决策点。

desc.en: The conversation was compacted (hint, or the prompt shrank sharply), so the cached prefix is gone: a free break point.
desc.zh-CN: 对话已被压缩（客户端提示或提示长度骤减），缓存前缀已失效：免费决策点。

desc.en: Nothing of the cached prefix is warm any more (the prompt changed at the start): a free break point.
desc.zh-CN: 缓存前缀已全部失效（提示开头已改变）：免费决策点。

desc.en: A new user message on a warm lineage: a switch would lose the cache, so it must pay for itself (or is an upgrade).
desc.zh-CN: 缓存仍有效的会话链上的新用户消息：切换会丢失缓存，必须划算（升级除外）。

desc.en: The model this lineage would use failed recently (429/5xx); another profile or a same-tier sibling was chosen.
desc.zh-CN: 该会话链应使用的模型近期失败（429/5xx），改用其他 inference profile 或同档位的模型。

desc.en: The router served what the client asked for (or the observe default for aliases) and only recorded what auto would choose.
desc.zh-CN: router 按客户端请求（别名则按观察默认模型）提供服务，只记录自动模式会选择什么。

desc.en: The router chose the served model.
desc.zh-CN: 由 router 选择实际服务的模型。

decision.reason.note: Key = parseReason(reason).key (research note §3.1): code, or code:variant. The full reason text is shown below the label.

desc.en: The client sent x-router-pin with a model the policy allows.
desc.zh-CN: 客户端通过 x-router-pin 指定了策略允许的模型。

desc.en: Auto mode, and the client requested a concrete model id instead of an alias.
desc.zh-CN: 自动模式下客户端请求了具体模型 ID 而非别名。

desc.en: The policy has no model pool for this API dialect, so the requested model is used.
desc.zh-CN: 策略中没有该 接口的模型池，因此使用请求的模型。

desc.en: Tier and model picked at the session's first request.
desc.zh-CN: 在会话首个请求时选定档位与模型。

label.zh-CN: 子 agent 开始时选择

desc.en: A new lineage under a known session root (detected by the router).
desc.zh-CN: 已知会话根下的新会话链（由 router 识别）。

label.zh-CN: 子 agent 开始时选择（客户端提示）

desc.en: The client marked a sub-agent start (x-router-boundary).
desc.zh-CN: 客户端通过 x-router-boundary 标记子 agent 开始。

desc.en: The client marked a new task; full decision without switch cost.
desc.zh-CN: 客户端标记新任务；完整决策，无切换成本。

label.zh-CN: 压缩后选择（客户端提示）

desc.en: The client marked a compaction; the old cache is lost anyway.
desc.zh-CN: 客户端标记了上下文压缩；旧缓存已无用。

desc.en: The prompt shrank far below the cached size, so the router treated it as a compaction.
desc.zh-CN: 提示长度远小于已缓存长度，router 视为上下文压缩。

desc.en: The cache TTL passed while the lineage was idle; full decision without switch cost.
desc.zh-CN: 会话链空闲期间缓存 TTL 已过；完整决策，无切换成本。

desc.en: No part of the cached prefix was reusable; full decision without switch cost.
desc.zh-CN: 缓存前缀已无可复用部分；完整决策，无切换成本。

label.zh-CN: 因上下文长度被迫切换

desc.en: The prompt no longer fits the current or desired model's context window (with headroom), so the router moved to a model that fits.
desc.zh-CN: 提示已超出当前或目标模型的上下文窗口（含余量），router 改用能容纳的模型。

label.zh-CN: 上下文限制解除后恢复

desc.en: The lineage had been forced off its tier by context size; the desired tier fits again, so it moved back.
desc.zh-CN: 会话链曾因上下文长度被迫离开原档位；现在目标档位重新可容纳，已切回。

desc.en: The current model is not in the pool (e.g. policy changed or an earlier pin), so the lineage moved into the pool.
desc.zh-CN: 当前模型不在模型池中（如策略变更或先前指定），会话链移入模型池。

desc.en: previous_response_id arrived but the router has no state for it (e.g. after a restart); the dialect default tier is used.
desc.zh-CN: 收到 previous_response_id 但 router 没有其状态（如重启后），使用该接口的默认档位。

desc.en: Tool loop, response chain or non-portable state: see the decision point.
desc.zh-CN: 工具循环、响应链或不可迁移状态：见决策点。

desc.en: The request continues an assistant message; it stays on the same model.
desc.zh-CN: 请求续写助手消息，保持同一模型。

label.en: Retained: switches only at break points

desc.en: The policy (userTurn: retain) switches only at free break points, not on user turns.
desc.zh-CN: 策略（userTurn: retain）只在免费决策点切换，不在用户新 turn 切换。

label.en: Retained: already on the desired tier

desc.en: The desired tier equals the current model's tier.
desc.zh-CN: 目标档位与当前模型档位相同。

desc.en: An upgrade was wanted but no eligible model of a higher tier exists.
desc.zh-CN: 需要升级，但没有可用的更高档位模型。

desc.en: A downgrade was wanted but no eligible model of a lower tier exists.
desc.zh-CN: 需要降级，但没有可用的更低档位模型。

desc.en: Moved to a higher tier on a user turn; upgrades are quality-driven and not cost-gated. The source says why.
desc.zh-CN: 在用户新 turn 升级到更高档位；升级以质量为准，不做成本门。来源说明原因。

desc.en: Moved to a cheaper tier on a user turn because the estimated saving over the horizon beats the cold-cache cost with margin.
desc.zh-CN: 在用户新 turn 降级到更便宜的档位：预计在评估窗口内的节省超过缓存失效成本并留有余量。

label.en: Downgrade held: too soon after a switch
label.zh-CN: 暂缓降级：距上次切换太近

desc.en: Hysteresis: fewer turns since the last switch than the policy minimum.
desc.zh-CN: 滞后保护：距上次切换的轮次少于策略最小值。

label.zh-CN: 暂缓降级：已达切换上限

desc.en: This lineage already made the policy's maximum number of cost-driven switches.
desc.zh-CN: 该会话链的成本驱动切换次数已达策略上限。

desc.en: Losing the warm cache would cost about as much as the cheaper model saves (see the estimate).
desc.zh-CN: 丢失有效缓存的成本与便宜模型节省的费用相当（见估算）。

label.zh-CN: 故障切换：其他 inference profile

desc.en: Same model through another inference profile (separate quota) after a 429.
desc.zh-CN: 429 后通过另一 inference profile（独立配额）使用同一模型。

desc.en: Every profile of the model failed (or the status does not rotate profiles); a same-tier sibling was chosen.
desc.zh-CN: 该模型所有 inference profile 均失败（或该状态不轮换配置），改用同档位模型。

desc.en: No alternative was possible (locked, or no sibling); the model was kept and the gateway fallback may serve the request.
desc.zh-CN: 无可用替代（锁定或无同档位模型），保持原模型，网关回退可能接管请求。

label.zh-CN: 工具循环内的故障切换

desc.en: All profiles failed during a tool loop with portable history, so a same-tier sibling took over mid-loop.
desc.zh-CN: 工具循环中所有 inference profile 失败且历史可迁移，由同档位模型在循环中接管。

desc.en: The model failed, but a previous_response_id chain must stay on the exact same profile.
desc.zh-CN: 模型失败，但 previous_response_id 响应链必须保持在同一 inference profile。

desc.en: The chosen model rejects an anthropic-beta the client sent, so the router picked a compatible model.
desc.zh-CN: 所选模型不支持客户端发送的 anthropic-beta，router 改选兼容的模型。

desc.en: The caller's tier limit (access cap) removed higher-tier models from the choice; this is not a routing saving.
desc.zh-CN: 调用方的档位上限移除了更高档位的模型；这不计为路由节省。

desc.en: Observe mode with an alias: the policy's observe default was served; the reason describes what auto would do.
desc.zh-CN: 观察模式下请求别名：提供策略的观察默认模型；原因描述的是自动模式的选择。

desc.en: No model fits within the headroom; the largest window was used.
desc.zh-CN: 没有模型能在余量内容纳该提示，使用窗口最大的模型。

label.zh-CN: 上下文门控回退：当前模型

desc.en: No model fits within the headroom; the current model still fits physically and was kept.
desc.zh-CN: 没有模型能在余量内容纳该提示；当前模型仍能实际容纳，因此保持。

label.en: Context gate fallback: cheapest that fits
label.zh-CN: 上下文门控回退：可容纳的最便宜模型

desc.en: No model fits within the headroom; the cheapest model that physically fits was used.
desc.zh-CN: 没有模型能在余量内容纳该提示，使用能实际容纳的最便宜模型。

desc.en: The assessor proposed a downgrade from a tier it may not downgrade from (default: only standard→fast); the lineage keeps its tier.
desc.zh-CN: 评估器建议从不允许降级的档位降级（默认仅允许 standard→fast），会话链保持原档位。

label.en: Projection adjusted for a beta feature
label.zh-CN: 预测已按 beta 功能调整

desc.en: Observe mode: the model auto would choose rejects a beta the client sent, so wouldChoose names a compatible model.
desc.zh-CN: 观察模式：自动模式会选择的模型不支持客户端的 beta，wouldChoose 改为兼容模型。

decision.source.note: The 'via <source>' part of break-point and forced-move reasons, and the <source> of 'upgrade:<source>'. First match wins in this order: hint, alias, rule, session tier, assessor, default.

desc.en: The client sent x-router-hint with a tier.
desc.zh-CN: 客户端通过 x-router-hint 指定档位。

desc.en: The requested alias maps to a tier in the policy.
desc.zh-CN: 请求的别名在策略中对应一个档位。

desc.en: Session-scoped tier: this lineage follows the tier of the session's root lineage.
desc.zh-CN: 会话级档位：该会话链沿用会话根会话链的档位。

desc.en: The root lineage has no model yet, so the pool default tier is used for now.
desc.zh-CN: 根会话链尚未选定模型，暂用模型池默认档位。

desc.en: Nothing else applied: the dialect pool's default tier.
desc.zh-CN: 无其他依据：使用该接口模型池的默认档位。

desc.en: The model the decision named (servedModel can differ after an in-request failover).
desc.zh-CN: 决策指定的模型（请求内故障切换后，实际服务模型可能不同）。

desc.en: Observe mode only: the model auto mode would have served. Used for the 'projected if auto' savings view.
desc.zh-CN: 仅观察模式：自动模式会提供的模型。用于“若启用自动”的节省预测。

desc.en: List-price estimate over the horizon on the current model, with its warm cache.
desc.zh-CN: 在当前模型上（缓存有效）评估窗口内的标价估算成本。

desc.en: List-price estimate over the horizon on the target model, starting with a cold cache.
desc.zh-CN: 在目标模型上（缓存从零开始）评估窗口内的标价估算成本。

desc.en: How many future calls the estimate covers (policy horizon).
desc.zh-CN: 估算覆盖的后续调用次数（策略 horizon）。

desc.en: Version of the routing policy that made the decision.
desc.zh-CN: 做出该决策的路由策略版本。

desc.en: Hash label of the client's tools and system prompt (identifies the client/agent kind, never the text).
desc.zh-CN: 客户端工具与系统提示的哈希标签（识别客户端/代理类型，不含原文）。

desc.en: The router's prompt size estimate at decision time (chars/4).
desc.zh-CN: 决策时 router 估算的提示长度（字符数/4）。

desc.en: A different model served than the one holding the cache (switch, failover or gateway fallback).
desc.zh-CN: 实际服务的模型不是持有缓存的模型（切换、故障切换或网关回退）。

desc.en: The cached prefix was last touched near or past its TTL.
desc.zh-CN: 缓存前缀上次使用时已接近或超过其 TTL。

desc.en: The client changed earlier parts of the prompt (tools, system or history), so the cache did not match.
desc.zh-CN: 客户端修改了提示的前部（工具、系统提示或历史），缓存无法匹配。

desc.en: Fewer cached tokens were read than expected and none of the known causes applies (often provider-side eviction).
desc.zh-CN: 读取的缓存词元少于预期，且不属于已知原因（常见于提供方驱逐缓存）。

desc.en: Tokens the router expected to be read from cache.
desc.zh-CN: router 预期从缓存读取的词元数。

desc.en: Tokens actually read from cache (usage).
desc.zh-CN: 实际从缓存读取的词元数（usage）。

desc.en: The assessor returned a valid assessment (which may still be 'no opinion', see outcome).
desc.zh-CN: 评估器返回了有效评估（仍可能是“无意见”，见结果）。

desc.en: The assessor could not answer (its own timeout, HTTP error, refusal, unparsable output); the decision used the usual tier.
desc.zh-CN: 评估器无法回答（自身超时、HTTP 错误、拒答、输出无法解析），决策使用常规档位。

desc.en: Core's hard bound (assessor timeout + 100 ms) was hit; the decision went ahead without an opinion.
desc.zh-CN: 达到核心的硬性上限（评估器超时 + 100 毫秒），决策在无意见的情况下继续。

desc.en: Building the card or the assessor call threw; no opinion.
desc.zh-CN: 构建任务卡或调用评估器时抛出异常；无意见。

desc.en: The assessor returned a malformed result (e.g. unknown tier); ignored.
desc.zh-CN: 评估器返回了格式错误的结果（如未知档位），已忽略。

desc.en: A fast rule matched and the task is fully specified and shallow.
desc.zh-CN: 命中 fast 规则，且任务定义完整、推理浅。

desc.en: A standard rule matched, or the multi-file-edit fact applied.
desc.zh-CN: 命中 standard 规则，或适用多文件编辑事实。

desc.en: A frontier rule matched, or a frontier fact (per the pack's mapping) applied.
desc.zh-CN: 命中 frontier 规则，或适用 frontier 事实（依提示词包映射）。

desc.en: The assessor's confidence was below the threshold.
desc.zh-CN: 评估器置信度低于阈值。

desc.en: Both a fast and a frontier rule matched.
desc.zh-CN: 同时命中 fast 与 frontier 规则。

desc.en: A fast rule matched, but the task is not fully specified or needs deeper reasoning than the pack allows for fast.
desc.zh-CN: 命中 fast 规则，但任务定义不完整或推理深度超出提示词包对 fast 的要求。

desc.en: No enabled rule and no fact signal applied.
desc.zh-CN: 没有命中任何启用规则或事实信号。

desc.en: The latest user message has no text; no model call, no cost.
desc.zh-CN: 最新用户消息没有文本；未调用模型，无费用。

desc.en: A short follow-up such as 'ok, continue'; no model call, no cost.
desc.zh-CN: 类似“好的，继续”的简短跟进；未调用模型，无费用。

desc.en: No response within the configured timeoutMs.
desc.zh-CN: 在配置的 timeoutMs 内没有响应。

desc.en: The call to Bedrock failed before a response.
desc.zh-CN: 调用 Bedrock 时在收到响应前失败。

desc.en: The model's response was not the expected JSON.
desc.zh-CN: 模型响应不是预期的 JSON。

label.zh-CN: 不可用：输出未通过校验

desc.en: The JSON did not satisfy the assessment contract (rules, facts, bounds). Billed.
desc.zh-CN: JSON 不符合评估契约（规则、事实、取值范围）。已计费。

desc.en: The assessor model refused to answer.
desc.zh-CN: 评估模型拒绝回答。

desc.en: The output hit its token cap before finishing.
desc.zh-CN: 输出在完成前达到词元上限。

desc.en: The router built a task card that failed validation (router bug); no call made.
desc.zh-CN: router 构建的任务卡未通过校验（router 缺陷），未调用。

desc.en: The request was aborted (client gone or core's bound) before the assessor finished.
desc.zh-CN: 评估器完成前请求被中止（客户端断开或达到核心上限）。

desc.en: Unexpected error inside the assessor (bug).
desc.zh-CN: 评估器内部意外错误（缺陷）。

desc.en: Core gave up after timeoutMs + 100 ms.
desc.zh-CN: 核心在 timeoutMs + 100 毫秒后放弃。

desc.en: Card thunk or assess() threw.
desc.zh-CN: 任务卡构建或 assess() 抛出异常。

desc.en: Malformed result from the assessor.
desc.zh-CN: 评估器返回的结果格式错误。

assessor.basis.note: Entries that are rule ids resolve through the pack archive by packVersion (rule tier + instruction text + the title from ruleTitles). The codes below are pack-independent.

desc.en: The assessor judged reasoning_depth = deep; supports frontier only in packs whose mapping lists it (v1–v2.1; not v2.2).
desc.zh-CN: 评估器判定 reasoning_depth = deep；仅在映射包含该事实的提示词包中支持 frontier（v1–v2.1，v2.2 不包含）。

desc.en: The conversation shows at least priorFailuresMin (default 2) failed attempts; supports frontier.
desc.zh-CN: 对话显示至少 priorFailuresMin（默认 2）次失败尝试；支持 frontier。

desc.en: The task edits code across files or modules and no fast rule matched; supports standard.
desc.zh-CN: 任务需跨文件或模块修改代码，且未命中 fast 规则；支持 standard。

desc.en: No-opinion code: confidence below threshold.
desc.zh-CN: 无意见代码：置信度低于阈值。

label.zh-CN: fast 与 frontier 同时命中

desc.en: No-opinion code: contradictory rule matches.
desc.zh-CN: 无意见代码：规则命中相互矛盾。

desc.en: No-opinion code: fast matched without the required specification/depth.
desc.zh-CN: 无意见代码：命中 fast 但不满足定义完整度/推理深度要求。

desc.en: No-opinion code.
desc.zh-CN: 无意见代码。

desc.en: The router replaced a value that was not a plain code.
desc.zh-CN: router 替换了非标准代码的值。

desc.en: The opinion was a downgrade from a tier the engine does not let the assessor downgrade from (default: only standard); clamped to the current tier, not applied.
desc.zh-CN: 该意见是从引擎不允许评估器降级的档位降级（默认仅 standard 可降），已钳制为当前档位，未应用。

desc.en: No consultations, no cost, no added latency.
desc.zh-CN: 不咨询评估器，无费用，无额外延迟。

desc.en: Consulted and logged; never changes the decision. Costs one assessor call per consulted turn and adds its latency.
desc.zh-CN: 咨询并记录，从不改变决策。每个被咨询的轮次产生一次评估器调用费用并增加其延迟。

desc.en: An auto-eligible opinion becomes the desired tier (after hint, alias, rules); upgrades apply at once, downgrades pass the usual cost gates.
desc.zh-CN: 可自动生效的意见成为目标档位（优先级低于提示、别名、规则）；升级立即生效，降级须通过常规成本门。

desc.en: Only rules marked auto in the pack may act (shipped packs v2.1/v2.2: none, so auto mode changes nothing).
desc.zh-CN: 仅提示词包中标记为 auto 的规则可生效（已发布的 v2.1/v2.2 没有，因此自动模式不改变任何决策）。

desc.en: Every enabled rule and fact signal may act, whatever the pack's flags. Experiment switch.
desc.zh-CN: 无论提示词包标记如何，所有启用规则与事实信号均可生效。实验开关。

desc.en: What the pack's mapping proposed, whether or not it was allowed to act.
desc.zh-CN: 提示词包映射给出的档位，无论是否允许生效。

desc.en: The tier passed to the routing engine; absent when no opinion or the basis is not auto-eligible.
desc.zh-CN: 传给 core 的档位；无意见或依据不可自动生效时为空。

desc.en: The assessor's self-reported confidence (0–1); 0 for skipped turns.
desc.zh-CN: 评估器自报置信度（0–1）；跳过的轮次为 0。

desc.en: True only when the opinion changed the chosen model (auto mode).
desc.zh-CN: 仅当意见改变了所选模型时为真（自动模式）。

desc.en: Same user turn as an earlier consultation (retry or parallel call): no new call, no cost.
desc.zh-CN: 与先前咨询属于同一用户新 turn（重试或并发调用）：无新调用，无费用。

desc.en: False for skipped turns and failures before the call.
desc.zh-CN: 跳过的轮次及调用前失败时为假。

desc.en: Time the decision waited for the assessor (part of decideMs).
desc.zh-CN: 决策等待评估器的时间（计入 decideMs）。

desc.en: List-price cost of this consultation, including billed invalid outputs.
desc.zh-CN: 本次咨询的标价费用，包括已计费的无效输出。

desc.en: Exact pack content (id + hash) the consultation used; resolves rule text.
desc.zh-CN: 本次咨询使用的提示词包确切内容（ID + 哈希），用于解析规则文本。

request.reason.note: Top-level RequestLog.reason (rejections and errors), not the routing reason.

desc.en: 404: path not served by the router.
desc.zh-CN: 404：router 不提供该路径。

desc.en: GET models: alias list returned.
desc.zh-CN: GET models：返回别名列表。

desc.en: 403: the router refuses all model requests until hop auth is configured (fail-closed).
desc.zh-CN: 403：未配置跳转认证前 router 拒绝所有模型请求（失败即关闭）。

desc.en: 403: the hop caller is not the configured gateway role.
desc.zh-CN: 403：跳转调用方不是配置的网关角色。

desc.en: 403: the hop came from an unexpected account.
desc.zh-CN: 403：跳转请求来自非预期账户。

desc.en: 413: request body over the router limit.
desc.zh-CN: 413：请求体超过 router 限制。

desc.en: 400: request body is not valid JSON.
desc.zh-CN: 400：请求体不是有效 JSON。

desc.en: 400: requested or pinned model is not one of the policy's models.
desc.zh-CN: 400：请求或指定的模型不在策略模型中。

desc.en: 503: the engine could not choose a model; the gateway fallback serves the request.
desc.zh-CN: 503：引擎无法选择模型；由网关回退处理请求。

desc.en: 499: client disconnected before the upstream call.
desc.zh-CN: 499：客户端在上游调用前断开。

label.zh-CN: 流式传输中客户端中止

desc.en: Client disconnected while the response was relayed.
desc.zh-CN: 转发响应期间客户端断开。

desc.en: The stream reached the router's maximum duration.
desc.zh-CN: 流式响应达到 router 最大时长。

desc.en: 502: upstream error after the response started.
desc.zh-CN: 502：响应开始后上游出错。

desc.en: 500: unexpected router error.
desc.zh-CN: 500：router 意外错误。

desc.en: 403: the router does not accept Expect: 100-continue.
desc.zh-CN: 403：router 不接受 Expect: 100-continue。

desc.en: 400: the requested or pinned model is above the caller's tier limit and not in its allowed pins.
desc.zh-CN: 400：请求或指定的模型超出调用方的档位上限，且不在允许指定的列表中。

label.en: No model within your limit fits
label.zh-CN: 上限内没有可容纳的模型

desc.en: 400: no model within the caller's tier limit fits the prompt's context size.
desc.zh-CN: 400：调用方档位上限内没有模型能容纳该提示的上下文长度。

desc.en: 403: the principal is disabled or blocked by an admin.
desc.zh-CN: 403：该身份已被管理员停用或拦截。

desc.en: 429: the principal's monthly list-price budget hard stop was reached.
desc.zh-CN: 429：该身份的月度标价预算已触发硬性停止。

desc.en: 401: No x-api-key was sent.
desc.zh-CN: 401：未发送 x-api-key。

desc.en: 401: x-api-key is not a JWT.
desc.zh-CN: 401：x-api-key 不是 JWT。

desc.en: 401: The token is not signed with RS256.
desc.zh-CN: 401：令牌未使用 RS256 签名。

desc.en: 401: The token's key id is not in the pool's current key set (key rotation; an alarm fires).
desc.zh-CN: 401：令牌的密钥 ID 不在用户池当前密钥集中（密钥轮换；会触发告警）。

desc.en: 401: The signature does not verify.
desc.zh-CN: 401：签名校验失败。

desc.en: 401: exp or nbf is outside the allowed window; the client should fetch a new token.
desc.zh-CN: 401：exp 或 nbf 超出允许范围；客户端应获取新令牌。

desc.en: 401: The token was not issued by this deployment's user pool.
desc.zh-CN: 401：令牌不是由本部署的用户池签发。

desc.en: 401: token_use is not 'access' (e.g. an ID token was sent).
desc.zh-CN: 401：token_use 不是 access（例如发送了 ID 令牌）。

desc.en: 401: The token lacks the router invoke scope.
desc.zh-CN: 401：令牌缺少 router 调用权限范围。

desc.en: 401: The token's app client is not allowed (only when a client allowlist is configured).
desc.zh-CN: 401：令牌的应用客户端不被允许（仅在配置了客户端允许列表时）。

desc.en: 401: The router has no usable key set (jwks.json missing or stale); an alarm fires.
desc.zh-CN: 401：router 没有可用的密钥集（jwks.json 缺失或过期）；会触发告警。

desc.en: No x-amz-security-token on the hop.
desc.zh-CN: 跳转请求不含 x-amz-security-token。

desc.en: Expected: the gateway mapping overwrote the token.
desc.zh-CN: 符合预期：网关映射覆盖了令牌。

desc.en: Security alert: the gateway's session token reached the router (mapping missing).
desc.zh-CN: 安全告警：网关会话令牌到达了 router（映射缺失）。

desc.en: The caller's Cognito access token was verified in the router.
desc.zh-CN: 调用方的 Cognito 访问令牌已在 router 中验证。

desc.en: No identity token; served in observe mode, refused in require mode.
desc.zh-CN: 无身份令牌；观察模式下照常服务，强制模式下拒绝。

desc.en: A console user (Cognito sub).
desc.zh-CN: 控制台用户（Cognito sub）。

desc.en: A machine client (client-credentials app client id).
desc.zh-CN: 机器客户端（client-credentials 应用客户端 ID）。

desc.en: No verified identity on this request.
desc.zh-CN: 该请求没有已验证的身份。

desc.en: Group from principals.json.
desc.zh-CN: 来自 principals.json 的用户组。

desc.en: Group from principals.json.
desc.zh-CN: 来自 principals.json 的用户组。

desc.zh-CN: 来自 principals.json 的用户组。

desc.zh-CN: router 已校验并启用该配置版本。

desc.en: The router refused this version and kept the last good config (see issue codes).
desc.zh-CN: router 拒绝了该版本并保留上一个有效配置（见问题代码）。

desc.en: The image's pack differs from the version approved in the config; the router runs the image's pack. Review the rules and re-save.
desc.zh-CN: 镜像中的提示词包与配置中批准的版本不同；router 使用镜像中的提示词包。请检查规则后重新保存。
